title: nectandra rubra
intro: Nectandra rubra, commonly known as Red Nectandra, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lauraceae. It is native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. The health benefits of Nectandra rubra include its potential to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant agent, which may help in reducing inflammation and protecting against cell damage. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenes, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antimalarial, antimicrobial, and anti-proliferative properties.
